content_zh:
真是……狗嘴吐不出象牙，不，牛牵到北京还是牛……也不对，应该说是，牛长大还是牛！
总之，从小就是花言巧语的小坏蛋，长大后直接升级成为滥情的坏家伙，真是令人一点都不感到意外。
ㄘˊㄟ，管他那么多做啥，寄信去也。
天信集团总裁办公室内，代理总裁掌尚仁像只猫乖乖坐在电脑前，对着视讯画面表现出一脸诚心忏悔样。
“爸，我知道错了，以后我每晚只和一个女生约会，不会再一晚约三个。”
“你还说！”掌信在另一头气呼呼地嚷着。
什么夜会正妹辣妹乳沟妹……真是丢脸丢到国外来！这几天他人还在德国旅游，就已接到商界许多朋友的电话，纷纷“称赞”他的二儿子真是了不得，气得他差点脑充血。
“难不成你要我跟男生约会？”掌尚仁为难的皱起眉头。
“你还说！”血压顿时又升高了。说起他这个二儿子，什么都好，尤其那张嘴超会讲话，死的都可以被他说成活的，可以轻易摆平所有女人。只是，女人缘再好，他可不可以稍微低调一点？
“爸，你别气，我来跟他说。”电脑萤幕上掌尚智神色肃穆的瞪着弟弟。
“嗨，大哥，你和未来大嫂在德国玩得很黑皮吧？没关系，为了你们的幸福，我牺牲一点无所谓，真的！千万不要太挂怀。虽然我牺牲掉的真的很多，包括睡眠、玩乐、交友……”
掌尚仁轻叹一口气，续道：“这个左金也实在有够贴心，怕我刚接下代理总裁的工作压力过大，会不小心崩溃，前几天晚上就执意要带我到夜店去玩，我都告诉他工作为重，不要玩过头，十二点就该回家睡觉，免得隔天爬不起来，赶不及开会，但他却……唉！又？Call了三个妹来，害我想走都走不了。”
站在一旁的特助左金，闻言傻眼，愣愣地手指着自己，张口结舌，真是哑巴吃黄连，有苦说不出。
什、什么呀！明明是二少带他去夜店的，他在一旁一直提醒二少隔天有个重要会议要开，请二少早点回家，但二少根本听不进去，还和刚认识的三个妹，打情骂俏了好几个钟头，结果一走出夜店，就被某杂志的人拍到了。
虽然妹很正，玩乐喝酒他也有份，但是，这么大的黑锅，二少怎么教他一个人扛下呢？
左金对着视讯和正主子掌尚智猛摇头，如果总裁大人真的生气怪罪下来，等他回台湾，说不定会炒他鱿鱼——不，人不是我？Call的啊，总裁大人！
“大哥，你也不要怪左金，他跟在你身边工作那么久，压力一定很大，偶尔放松一下，OK的嘛！”
他大哥为了让未来大嫂艾飞儿能让未来公婆认同，不惜把“总裁”这个重责大任丢给他扛，带着心爱的女人飞往德国，去和他们爸妈培养感情。
担心他一时无法进入状况，大哥还把他的总裁私人特助左金丢给他用。
真的不得不说，要找人扛黑锅时，左金这家伙还真能派上用场，呵呵。

“总裁，我没……没有啊！”掌尚仁那番话让左金更加冷汗直流，他拚命摇头，含泪咬唇，就怕世界另一端的总裁真的相信二少的话。
掌尚智睨了左金一眼，左金跟着他一段不算短的时间，掌尚仁当他的大弟更是长达二十八个年头，谁会上夜店搞怪，他还不清楚吗？
不想谈大弟的私事，每个人都有他自己想过的生活方式，上不上夜店、把不把妹，他不想干预。
“尚仁，我在这里认识一位专门代理德国时尚名品男装的台湾代理商，我对这商品很有兴趣，想让他在天信百货设柜，这几天，你找天信百货的几个高级干部开个会，评估一下，我会请代理商把资料传给你……”虽然人在国外，对公司有利的事，掌尚智还是会尽力去做。“另外天信金控……”
谈起公事，掌尚智是欲罢不能，兄弟俩来来回回讨论近两个钟头，憋尿憋到快ㄍㄧㄥ不住的掌尚仁则是欲语还休。
“大、大哥……”
“基金会那边……”
“大哥，请容小弟我先告退一步，再不上厕所，我的‘天信水库’就要溃堤了。”
才不管彼端的人是否仍兴致勃勃说个不停，他可不想在他当代理总裁期间因“洪水爆发”淹没总裁办公室一事，又登上八卦周刊头条，到时，别说老头没面子，又要气得嚷嚷丢脸丢到国外去，人在国内的他才真正没面子咧！
到时候，他拿什么脸上夜店把妹？
第1章(2)
冲到休息室内的洗手间“解放”完毕出来，电脑已关闭。
“嗯？我大哥不继续讨论了？”
“总裁说今天到此为止，让你休息一下。”左金露出哀怨的眼神，“二少，你怎么跟总裁说……说是我带你去上夜店的？”
“左金，我听到你的眼睛在说话耶。”
“嗄？”
“你的右眼埋怨我让你背黑锅，左眼感激我带他去夜店看了很多正妹。”掌尚仁挑眉一笑。
左金愣住，二少完全料中他心里想的。
虽然扛下黑锅觉得很委屈，但是二少带他去夜店见世面，也算是一种不同的人生体验。夜店他其实也去过几次，但从没像二少带他去那晚一样，好多辣妹主动围过来，二少就像是个吸魂者——不，像块磁铁，会吸引辣妹的磁铁，周刊拍到的只有三个妹，其实在夜店，围在他们身边的辣妹多到数不清。
“呃，二少……”

“师父有难弟子服其劳，现在我是你师父，师父出事，当然由你扛，还要我点醒你，懂不懂尊师重道的道理啊你！”
“师父？！”他有拜师吗？
“没错！你这个傻蛋，每天傻傻工作，泡妞都不会。”掌尚仁挑眉，“趁我大哥不在，我会把毕生的泡妞绝学，全都教给你，还不快叫一声师父。”
说着，敲了一下傻蛋的头。
“师父……不，二少，我、我也想交女朋友，可是，可不可以不要去夜店？”
“你歧视上夜店的女生？”眼微眯，危险意味十足。
“不，不是！我们暂时别去了，要是再让狗仔队拍到……”他小的有十颗头都不够被正主子砍。
“反正你已经扛一次罪了，多扛几次，习惯就好。”掌尚仁正色的拍拍他的肩。
“二少……”委屈，无言，他还想要这份高薪工作耶。
“吓得你屁滚尿流了？”掌尚仁揶揄着，“说你傻蛋还一点都不为过，我大哥是什么人？”
“总裁大人。”
“呃，是啦，可是我没在问你，不用回答，傻蛋。”
“喔。”
“我大哥，你的总裁大人，他头脑清楚得很，谁带谁上夜店，他心中有数，而且这种红豆中挑绿豆的小事，他才没兴趣管。”
他是个很有良心的好人好不好，不会干出“别人家的孩子死给它去”这种没天良的事。左金虽然是他大哥的特助，但现在他暂时是他的手下，他不会让他死得太凄惨的。
“左金，你放心，我会把你‘视如已出’的。”拍拍傻蛋的肩，掌尚仁一脸正经样。
“嗄？”视如已出？他也不过小二少几岁而已，二少生得出他来吗？
“呃，应该说视如兄弟才对，我儿子应该不会这么傻，而且一定比你帅很多。”
“……”这叫他说什么好呢？
“好了，正经点，工作喽。”

“……”又无言，他一直很正经，只是某人不……不太正经。
content_en:
It's true... A dog's mouth can't spit out ivory. No, a cow will still be a cow when it is brought to Beijing... That's not right either. It should be said that when a cow grows up, it will still be a cow!
In short, it is not surprising at all that he has been a smooth-talking bad guy since he was a child, and he directly upgraded to a sentimental bad guy when he grew up.
ㄘˊㄟ, no matter what he does, just send him a letter.
In the office of the president of Tianxin Group, acting president Zhang Shangren sat obediently in front of the computer like a cat, looking at the video screen with a look of sincere remorse.
"Dad, I know I was wrong. From now on, I will only date one girl every night, and I will not date three girls a night again."
"You still say that!" Zhang Xin yelled angrily from the other end.
What kind of night party hot girl with cleavage...it's really embarrassing to send her to a foreign country! In the past few days, while he was traveling in Germany, he had already received calls from many friends in the business community. They all "complied" that his second son was really amazing. He was so angry that he almost had a cerebral congestion.
"Is it possible that you want me to date a boy?" Zhang Shangren frowned in embarrassment.
"You still said that!" The blood pressure suddenly rose again. Speaking of his second son, he was good at everything, especially his mouth that was very good at talking. He could talk people into living things, and he could easily deal with all women. However, no matter how good the relationship with women is, can he be a little more low-key?
"Dad, don't be angry, I'll tell him." Palm Shangzhi stared at his younger brother solemnly on the computer screen.
"Hey, big brother, you and your future sister-in-law are having a lot of fun in Germany, right? It doesn't matter, it doesn't matter if I sacrifice a little for your happiness, really! Don't worry too much. Although I really sacrifice a lot, including sleep, fun, friends..."
Zhang Shangren sighed softly and continued: "This Zuo Jin is really considerate. He was afraid that I would be too stressed out when I took over the job as acting president and would accidentally collapse. A few nights ago, he insisted on taking me to a nightclub. I told him that work is the most important thing and not to overdo it. He should go home and sleep at twelve o'clock, so as not to be unable to get up the next day and be late for the meeting, but he... ugh! Again? He called three girls, which made it impossible for me to leave even if I wanted to."
The special assistant Zuo Jin who was standing aside was dumbfounded when he heard this. He pointed at himself blankly and was speechless. He was really dumb and couldn't tell the pain.
W-what! It was obviously the Second Young Master who took him to the nightclub. He kept reminding the Second Young Master that there was an important meeting to be held the next day and asked the Second Young Master to go home early, but the Second Young Master would not listen at all. He also flirted with three girls he had just met for several hours. As a result, as soon as he walked out of the nightclub, he was photographed by someone from a magazine.
Although the girl is very upright and he has a share in having fun and drinking, but how can the second young master teach him to shoulder such a big blame?
Zuo Jin shook his head violently at the video and his boss, Shang Zhi. If the CEO was really angry and blamed him, he might be fired when he returns to Taiwan - no, it's not me? Call, Mr. President!
"Brother, don't blame Zuo Jin. He has been working beside you for so long, so he must be under a lot of pressure. It's okay to relax once in a while!"
In order to make his future sister-in-law Ai Feier recognized by his future parents-in-law, his eldest brother did not hesitate to leave him with the important responsibility of "president" and flew to Germany with his beloved woman to cultivate a relationship with their parents.
Worried that he would not be able to enter the situation for a while, the eldest brother also gave him Zuo Jin, his personal assistant to the president.
I really have to say that when you need someone to take the blame, Zuo Jin can really come in handy, haha.
"President, I didn't... no!" Zhang Shangren's words made Zuo Jin sweat even more. He shook his head desperately and bit his lip with tears in his eyes, fearing that the CEO on the other side of the world would really believe what the second young master said.
Zhang Shangzhi glanced at Zuo Jin. Zuo Jin had followed him for a short period of time. Zhang Shangren had been his eldest brother for twenty-eight years. Didn't he still know who would go to the nightclub to cause mischief?
I don’t want to talk about Dadi’s personal affairs, everyone has his ownHe didn't want to interfere with the lifestyle he wanted to live, whether he could go to nightclubs or pick up girls.
"Shangren, I know a Taiwanese agent here who specializes in German fashionable men's clothing. I am very interested in this product and want him to set up a counter in Tianxin Department Store. In the past few days, you have a meeting with several senior officials of Tianxin Department Store to make an evaluation. I will ask the agent to pass the information to you..." Although he is abroad, Zhang Shangzhi will still try his best to do things that are beneficial to the company. "In addition, Tianxin Financial Holdings..."
When it came to talking about business, Zhang Shangzhi couldn't stop talking. The two brothers discussed it back and forth for nearly two hours. Zhang Shangren, who was holding his urine until he couldn't hold it in anymore, couldn't stop talking.
"Big, big brother..."
"Over there at the Foundation..."
"Brother, please allow me to take a step back. If I don't go to the toilet, my Tianxin Reservoir will burst."
He didn't care whether the person on the other side was still talking enthusiastically, but he didn't want to make the headlines of Gossip Weekly when he was the acting president because of the "flood" that submerged the president's office. By then, not only would the old man have no face, but he would be so angry that he would be embarrassed and sent abroad. He would be truly shameless at home!
When the time comes, what will he do to pick up girls in nightclubs?
Chapter 1(2)
I rushed to the restroom in the lounge and came out after "liberation". The computer was turned off.
"Huh? My eldest brother is not going to continue the discussion?"
"The president said that's the end of the day and he wants you to take a rest." Zuo Jin showed a sad look in his eyes, "Second Young Master, how did you tell the president... that I took you to the nightclub?"
"Zuo Jin, I hear your eyes talking."
"Huh?"
"Your right eye blames me for letting you take the blame, and your left eye is grateful that I took him to the nightclub to see many pretty girls." Zhang Shangren raised his eyebrows and smiled.
Zuo Jin was stunned. The Second Young Master completely expected what he was thinking.
Although he felt aggrieved to take the blame, it was a different life experience for him to take him to a nightclub to see the world. He had actually been to nightclubs several times, but never like the night when Er Shao took him there. Many hot girls gathered around him. Er Shao was like a soul-attractor - no, like a magnet, a magnet that attracted hot girls. There were only three girls photographed in the magazine. In fact, there were countless hot girls surrounding them in the nightclub.
"Uh, Second Young Master..."
"Master, if the disciple is in trouble, I will do my duty. Now I am your master. If something happens to the master, of course it will be your responsibility. You want me to wake you up, do you understand the principle of respecting the teacher and respecting the Tao!"
"Master?!" Did he become a disciple?
"That's right! You idiot, you work stupidly every day and you don't know how to pick up girls." Zhang Shangren raised his eyebrows, "While my elder brother is not here, I will teach you all the secrets of picking up girls in my life. Why don't you call me Master."
As he said that, he knocked the fool on the head.
"Master... no, Second Young Master, I, I also want to have a girlfriend, but can you please not go to nightclubs?"
"Do you discriminate against girls who go to nightclubs?" His eyes narrowed, full of danger.
"No, it's not! Let's not go there for now. If the paparazzi take pictures again..." He had ten heads, which were not enough to be chopped off by his real master.
"Anyway, you have already shouldered the crime once. If you bear it a few more times, you will get used to it." Zhang Shangren patted his shoulder sternly.
"Second Young Master..." He was aggrieved and speechless. He still wanted this high-paying job.
"You were so scared that you peeed?" Zhang Shangren teased, "It's not an exaggeration to say you are stupid. Who is my eldest brother?"
"Mr. President."
"Uh, yes, but I'm not asking you, so there's no need to answer, idiot."
"Oh."
"My eldest brother, your CEO, he has a very clear mind. He knows who brings whom to the nightclub, and he has no interest in dealing with such trivial matters as picking green beans among red beans."
He is a good and conscientious person, okay? He would not do such an unscrupulous thing as "leaving other people's children to death". Although Zuo Jin is his eldest brother's special assistant, now heHe is his subordinate for the time being, and he will not let him die too miserably.
"Zuo Jin, don't worry, I will treat you as if you are already out." He patted Silly Man on the shoulder, Zhang Shangren looked serious.
"Huh?" Seems it's gone? He is only a few years old, the second young master. Can the second young master give birth to him?
"Well, I should say we treat him like a brother. My son shouldn't be so stupid, and he must be much more handsome than you."
"..." What should he say?
"Okay, let's get down to business."
"..." Wu Yan, he has always been serious, but someone is not... not very serious.
